name: bond_command
description: Execute one explicit Q order and wait for the authoritative engine result. Movement, camera hacks, vault access, relic collection, or nearby suspicious guard knockdown.

arguments.name: type
arguments.description: One uppercase string: MOVE, STOP, CONTINUE, HACK_CAMERA, OPEN_VAULT, TAKE_RELIC, KNOCK_DOWN_GUARD.

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: MOVE: gallery, security, vault, entrance. HACK_CAMERA: current or discovered camera_2, camera_4, or camera_5. Omit entirely for STOP, CONTINUE, OPEN_VAULT, TAKE_RELIC.

arguments.name: via
arguments.description: Optional for MOVE only: left or right. Use left when Q asks for the left/west side of Main Hall. Omit entirely for all other actions.
